program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((four (first (find-color g 4)))
                (fr (first four))
                (fc (second four))
                (src-r1 (* (quotient fr 4) 4))
                (src-c1 (* (quotient fc 4) 4))
                (dst-r1 (* (- fr src-r1) 4))
                (dst-c1 (* (- fc src-c1) 4))
                (src-cells (filter (lambda (rc)
                                     (let ((v (at g (first rc) (second rc))))
                                       (and (!= v 0) (!= v 5))))
                                   (positions-in-rect src-r1
                                                      src-c1
                                                      (+ src-r1 2)
                                                      (+ src-c1 2))))
                (out-g (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 5) 5 0))))
           (reduce (lambda (gg p)
                     (let* ((r (first p))
                            (c (second p))
                            (nr (+ dst-r1 (- r src-r1)))
                            (nc (+ dst-c1 (- c src-c1))))
                       (set-cell gg nr nc (at g r c))))
                   out-g
                   src-cells))))
